**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Job Overview

**As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will have technical ownership of the mechanical design of laser products and related subsystems. You will work hands-on with the development of robust, opto-mechanical solutions, covering the full lifecycle from early concepts and prototypes to qualification and manufacturing release. The role requires strong technical judgment, practical engineering skills, and the ability to translate requirements into manufacturable designs.

You will be part of the mechanical engineering team in Denmark, working in cross-functional product development projects within a global organization. You will collaborate closely with optical and electronics engineers, suppliers, and manufacturing to ensure technically sound and high-quality solutions.

NKT Photonics offers a supportive working environment with a strong focus on both professional development and work-life balance. We continue to invest in our facilities, tools, and teams to support long-term growth.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Take responsibility for mechanical development of laser products throughout the full product lifecycle.

• Collaborate closely with mechanical engineers, optical, and electronics engineers on concept development, prototyping, and design maturation.

• Own defined work packages within product development projects and contribute to planning, execution, and delivery together with project managers.

• Design precision mechanical and opto-mechanical components including creation of 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.

• Support prototype assembly, functional testing, and product qualification.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, and continuous product improvement.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to relevant standards.

• Contribute to manufacturing release and production ramp-up.

• Work with purchasing and suppliers to identify cost-effective manufacturing solutions for parts and subassemblies, including sourcing and qualifications of new suppliers.

**Your Skills And Experience

**

• A Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering

• 5+ years of experience with pression mechanics or industrial high-tech equipment.

• Strong 3D CAD skills: SolidWorks experience is preferred

• Experience with opto-mechanical systems, components, or laser products is highly advantageous.

• Ability to take ownership and lead mechanical product development.

• Experience working with design for reliability and manufacturability.

• Strong competence in robust design methodologies.

• Solid knowledge of mechanical design and drawing standards for precision CNC machined and sheet metal parts.

• Hands-on practical skills and knowledge of state-of-the-art manufacturing methods.

• Practical experience with 3D printing and basic mechanical workshop tools.

• Knowledge of materials science.

• Experience with PLM/Vault systems and standard Microsoft tools (Excel, Outlook, etc.)

• Expertise with finite element analysis

• Experience with thermal flow simulations.

• Well-developed analytical abilities: able to question complex information, identify root causes, and deliver strong technical solutions.

• Fluent English written and spoken (English is the official company language).

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.

The Role

At Truesec Denmark, we're on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also:

• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today.

• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met.

• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general.

• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling.

• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations.

• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team.

• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.

Your Potential Background

To succeed in this role, we believe that you

• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.

• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.

• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.

• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.

• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.

• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.

• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Flügger is a proud supplier to professional painters and quality-conscious consumers. We are at the forefront of the movement toward a greener construction industry and support professional painters through partnerships, high-quality products, and inspiring design.

We are looking for an AI & MarTech Lead to join our growing Digital Sales team at Flügger!

At Flügger Group A/S, you will join the Digital Sales team, where we thrive in the intersection between strategy, technology and sales. You will play a pivotal role in how AI visibility defines sales strategy.

The way people find and choose paint is changing. Search is moving into AI engines, and agentic commerce is coming fast. Whoever gets found in that new landscape wins the customer long before they reach a shelf or a shop. That makes our product data one of our most valuable commercial assets, and this role is where we turn it into an advantage.

This is a role with real reach. You own the MarTech and CRM landscape, performance marketing and our AI discoverability, and you stay hands-on in the data layer yourself. You’ll build one data foundation that serves both our product feeds and AI: pay once, benefit twice. The work you do shapes what our commercial strategy can realistically aim for over the next few years.

You will report to Head of Digital Sales & Standards and take people responsibility for two specialists within Performance Marketing and CRM.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Leadership and team development

• You lead and develop the MarTech & CRM team, giving both specialists direction, sparring and technical support

• You set the frame for the team’s tools and budget

Data and technical foundation

• You own the technical data and make large volumes of data LLM-ready

• You optimise our product feeds technically and keep the data complete and correct

• You keep our CRM (HubSpot) and integration landscape healthy

• You scale our colour-as-a-product feed from a proven few hundred toward 5000+ by automating SKU, barcode and feed generation rather than doing it manually

AI discoverability and strategy

• You own our AI discoverability and structure our data, so we’re found by AI engines today and ready for agentic commerce tomorrow

• You build one data foundation that powers all channels and AI

• You follow developments within GEO, AI search and agentic commerce, and translate them into concrete initiatives

• You make sure MarTech and performance marketing pull in the same direction as the commercial strategy

Collaboration across the business

• You take part in MarTech, CRM and data forums across Commercial

• You work closely with Platform & Experience, Analytics and Online Products

How we measure success

• Share of products online and correct in product feeds, scaling toward 5.000+ colours

• Performance marketing efficiency measured on ROAS and qualified leads

• Our presence and findability in AI search over time

Who are you?

You are technically strong and comfortable with your hands in the data, while also able to set direction for others. You understand that MarTech only creates value when tools and data genuinely support commercial goals, and you can bridge the commercial and technical sides of the business.

We imagine that you:

• Have solid MarTech and CRM experience and can take ownership of an integration landscape, ideally including HubSpot

• Understand data flows in depth and can make data LLM-ready yourself

• Have experience with product feeds and feed optimisation at scale

• Know the performance marketing discipline well enough to lead and challenge a specialist in it

• Are forward-looking on AI-discoverability, GEO and agentic commerce

• Have leadership experience, or are ready to take that step without letting go of the craft

• Communicate comfortably in English; Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Why join our team?

• Ownership from day one. AI discoverability is a domain we’re building, not one you inherit fully formed. You set the direction, and you have the mandate and budget to act on it.

• Visible impact. Digital Sales sits close to commercial decisions. What you build in the data shows directly in how we’re found, how we sell, and where the strategy goes next.

• Hand-on leadership. You won’t be managed away from the work. This is a role where technical depth is an asset, not something you leave behind when you get a team.

• A team that works across the boundary. We sit between strategy, technology and sales, and we work closely with Platform & Experience, Analytics and Online Products rather than in silo.

• A brand with real substance behind it. Flügger has been making colour for generations, and we’re now bringing that into an AI-driven commercial reality. That’s a rare combination of heritage and greenfield work.

Does this sound like you?

Send your application no later than 26th of October. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait too long to apply.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Head of Digital Sales & Standards, Jens Havreballe on +45 20 87 03 36.

For mere information

I Flügger ser vi udelukkende på kombinationen af personlige og faglige kompetencer og kvalifikationer, når vi vurderer kandidaters egnethed. Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og individets ret til at være sig selv med lige muligheder.

Om Flügger

Flügger Group er en international børsnoteret virksomhed med en omsætning på ca. 2,2 milliarder DKK og ca. 1700 medarbejdere på tværs af grænser. Vi er en familiegrundlagt og -ledet virksomhed, stor nok til at gøre en forskel, men stadig lille nok til at bevare vores entreprenørånd. Vores team består af dedikerede og dygtige mennesker, der virkelig engagerer sig og opbygger en uovertruffen ekspertise indefra.

Working at Flügger

We are an informal, down-to-earth workplace with high ambitions, and we constantly strive to improve ourselves and our business. Our employees are the very core of the company and key to our continued success. When our employees grow, Flügger grows, making continuous development a high priority in Flügger.

Our headquarter is based in Denmark but you will find that we also have positions in Sweden, Norway, Poland, Iceland and China. We pride ourselves on our international outlook and it is important for us to create a culture of diversity, well-being, and good cooperation across departments throughout Flügger. We believe that a diverse team fosters creativity and drives success.

Ready for a colourful career at Flügger?

When you work at Flügger Group, you help bring colour and joy to countless customer projects, whether they are in urban spaces or in private homes. To us, it is not just about paints and painting products; it is about providing our customers with professional advice and the right solution that guarantees a successful outcome.

So, if you are passionate about making a difference and you thrive in a collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

Who are we looking for?

At Lenus, we’re building the future of holistic health. As a Key Account Manager in our Copenhagen office, you’ll target, onboard, and support the leading online health and fitness coaches across the globe to achieve lasting success. If you’re passionate about sales, branding, and strategic growth and thrive on creating impactful relationships, this role might be the perfect fit for you. We’re looking for a natural persuader with a collaborative mindset, and a vision to empower others in their journey to success.

What you’ll do

• Target & Empower Coaches: You will build your portfolio of coaches by scouting, reaching out, pitching, and convincing them to partner with Lenus.

• Guiding Health Coaches: Act as a strategic commercial partner to a portfolio of 15-20 coaches through weekly meetings, daily calls and actionable growth plans.

• Enabling Business Growth: Develop brand positioning, content plans, campaigns, and go-to-market activities together with coaches and internal marketing teams.

• Building Partnerships: Foster trust-based relationships with coaches that go beyond transactions, making you their go-to collaborator and creates a safe space for difficult conversations to happen.

• Ensuring Quality Excellence: Maintain accurate, timely pipeline and portfolio data in the CRM, including next steps, commercial forecasts, risks, and opportunities. This role rewards strong prioritisation and ownership and may occasionally require flexibility outside standard working hours.

Who you are

• You have a commercial mindset and come from a background in sales, marketing or account management . You are driven by setting ambitious goals and reaching them!

• You’re an exceptional relationship builder who can connect with anyone and foster partnerships based on mutual trust and respect. Adapting to different people and situations comes naturally to you and both are met with positive

• You're a visionary, someone who naturally motivates and influences those around them. You lead with a ‘we can do it’ energy, reframing challenges as opportunities for everyone you work with.

• You embrace the coach mindset and provide candid and constructive feedback delivered with clarity and compassion. When receiving feedback you listen with curiosity, learn from past mistakes and always strive to improve yourself.

• You’re fluent in English and Danish.

Even if you don’t match all of the requirements above, we would love to hear from you! Our most successful colleagues in this role come from vastly different backgrounds, and the key to success is anchored in your personality and mindset more so than in your professional background.

Your first 90 days

Days 1-30: Learn & Connect

• You’ll spend the majority of your time being onboarded into our product and commercial processes. By shadowing core workflows you’ll build a solid understanding of the coach lifecycle, team targets, CRM standards, and internal offerings. Lastly, you’ll build relationships with your colleagues and key collaborators and agree on a personal ramp-up plan with your Team Lead.

Days 31-60: Begin Owning

• You’ll take ownership of an initial coach portfolio and prospect pipeline, while beginning to have your first coach meetings with the support of a colleague. You’ll document growth plans and next steps and have signed your first 2 coaches on your own. You’re steadily integrating into the Lenus work culture and begin to foster real connections with the people around you.

Days 61-90: Operate Independently

• By this point, you’re ready to independently manage your portfolio and weekly priorities, while maintaining a qualified pipeline leading you to sign 2 new coaches per month. You have a good grasp of our business model and use data effectively to create growth forecasts and present portfolio overviews. You’re now an integrated part of our community and partake in local events, breakfasts and sports activities together with your colleagues.

Why this role is right for you

**Uncapped Earnings:**At Lenus, hard work pays off. The more you give it your all, the more you grow. Top performers earn big because they deliver big. Your effort, strategy, and results directly shape your success and income.

**A Steep Learning Curve:**From day one, you’ll step into a world of learning where you’ll master advanced sales, marketing, and business growth strategies. Within months, you’ll go from talented to top-tier, surrounded by mentors who will push you to your next level.

**Travel & Global Community:**Join a network of over 300 colleagues worldwide, visit our international offices, and collaborate across borders. You’ll be part of a culture that’s fast-paced, connected, and full of energy.

**Creative Freedom & Purpose:**You’ll work directly with top online health and fitness coaches helping them build thriving businesses that change lives. Every day is different. Every project is meaningful. You’ll lead key clients, design impactful strategies, and never have a dull day.

About Lenus

Lenus was founded in Denmark by Bertram Thorslund, in 2016. We are a health technology company that empowers health coaches to scale their businesses through the use of pioneering technology and our in-house business, health and innovation expertise.

We’re inspiring a new generation of health coaches. People who have the power to move not only bodies, but minds too. We are at the forefront of an industry under rapid transformation and our strategic innovations pave the path for the change we want to see. Happier and healthier people.

Today, Lenus is headquartered in Copenhagen, with offices in New York, London, Stockholm, Berlin, Hamburg, Madrid, Helsinki, Oslo, Toronto, Miami, Southern California, Lisbon, Amsterdam, Sydney & beyond.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Mechanical SME at atNorth

**Are you a seasoned mechanical engineering expert with a passion for delivering and operating world-class data centre infrastructure? At atNorth, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of sustainable, high-performance data centres across the Nordics. As the technical authority for mechanical systems and critical cooling infrastructure, you will provide expert guidance across both project delivery and operations, ensuring technical excellence, engineering integrity, and operational reliability throughout the asset lifecycle.

This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with strategic influence, working closely with Operations, Design, Development, and industry-leading specialists to drive innovation in one of the fastest-growing sectors in Europe.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Act as the technical authority and signatory for mechanical engineering designs, calculations, specifications, standards, and operational procedures.

• Provide expert leadership across critical mechanical infrastructure, including cooling systems, chillers, evaporative and DX cooling technologies, water distribution systems, fire suppression systems, and associated controls.

• Support design reviews, engineering assurance, commissioning activities, and technical handovers to ensure operational readiness and long-term reliability.

• Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical specifications, operational procedures, and best-practice frameworks across atNorth's Nordic data centre portfolio.

• Collaborate closely with Design, Development, and Operations teams to ensure seamless integration of new infrastructure and effective transition into operations.

• Lead technical investigations, troubleshooting efforts, and root-cause analyses for complex mechanical incidents and performance issues.

• Serve as the primary mechanical engineering advisor for internal stakeholders, clients, consultants, and vendors.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry developments, including liquid cooling, energy efficiency solutions, and advanced thermal-management technologies.

• Drive training, technical mentoring, and knowledge sharing across operational and engineering teams to strengthen capability and consistency.

• Support asset lifecycle planning, maintenance strategies, resilience improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives across the portfolio.

**Your profile:

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering, critical infrastructure, or mission-critical environments, including progression into senior technical leadership roles.

• Extensive experience delivering data centre engineering projects, with deep expertise in cooling and thermal-management systems, including chillers, liquid cooling technologies, water distribution systems, and other critical mechanical infrastructure.

• Strong understanding of commissioning, system integration, operational readiness, maintenance strategies, and asset lifecycle management.

• Proven experience acting as a technical authority, reviewing and approving engineering designs, technical documentation, specifications, and operational standards.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset, combined with the confidence to challenge, influence, and drive high engineering standards across multiple sites, projects, and regions.

• Experience with sustainable cooling solutions and energy-efficient data centre technologies is considered an advantage.

• Fluent English and willingness to travel across the Nordic region as required.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

**Job Description

**Are you customer-focused, structured and motivated by working in an operational area where quality, documentation and service delivery are key? Do you enjoy supporting customers and advisers, coordinating with internal stakeholders and ensuring that processes run efficiently from start to finish?

We are looking for a detail-oriented colleague to join our Customer Handling Team/Tax Services team in Copenhagen. The team serves as a primary point of contact for advisers and customers and plays an important role in onboarding, documentation management, customer support and service delivery related to securities tax services.

On clients’ behalf, Danske Bank applies for a reduction in foreign tax on returns from securities held in customers’ custody accounts. This includes relief of foreign dividend and interest tax, either at source or through tax reclaim processes. The service is complementary to Danske Bank’s custody service and is particularly relevant for clients earning income on foreign financial instruments, where a tax reduction may be available under applicable double taxation agreements.

**About Securities Tax Services

**Securities Tax Services is part of Danske Bank’s tax area and is responsible for handling services related to withholding tax on securities. The area consists of several teams located in Denmark and Lithuania, working closely together across locations, functions and customer segments.

You will join a team of skilled specialists who support corporate, institutional and other customer segments. We value collaboration, curiosity, continuous learning and a strong focus on delivering high-quality service in a well-controlled environment.

**Your role

**As a team member in Customer Handling, you will support customers and advisers with inquiries, documentation and service-related matters. You will help ensure that customer agreements, onboarding, offboarding and service changes are handled correctly and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Acting as a first point of contact for customer and adviser inquiries

• Handling customer onboarding and offboarding activities

• Ensuring customer agreements and service documentation are sent, received and registered correctly

• Collecting, reviewing and maintaining required customer documentation

• Supporting changes to customer preferences and service setups

• Following up with customers and advisers on outstanding documentation and requests

• Coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient service delivery

• Participating in client meetings and supporting customer relationship management

• Maintaining and updating information in internal systems

• Supporting controls to ensure accurate and compliant processing

• Contributing to continuous improvement of customer processes and service quality

The role combines recurring operational tasks with customer interaction and collaboration across teams. You will get exposure to securities services, withholding tax processes, custody-related services and post-trade operations.

**About You

**We are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who enjoys working with customers, documentation and operational processes. You take ownership of tasks, communicate clearly and can manage several activities while maintaining attention to detail.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from customer service, client support, operations, financial services or a similar area

• Have a customer-centric mindset and strong communication skills

• Are comfortable working with documentation, regulations and operational processes

• Can manage multiple tasks while maintaining high accuracy

• Collaborate well with colleagues and stakeholders across teams and locations

• Are proactive, curious and willing to learn in a complex environment

• Have strong English skills, both written and spoken

Experience from Asset Services, post-trade operations, custody services or withholding tax is considered an advantage.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team environment where you can develop your expertise through varied work and mentorship opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing. Your career will progress through exposure to diverse tax challenges and continuous learning opportunities.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would be delighted to hear from you if this opportunity aligns with your career aspirations. Please reach out to our hiring manager Nicolai William Schou Hansen at nicoh@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We look forward to hearing from you!

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Are you driven by working with cutting-edge photonics technology that powers the future of Quantum Technologies? Do you want to be at the forefront of shaping the next generation of Laser Systems in quantum computers, sensors and communication systems? Do you find complex problems as exciting challenges and thrive on transforming them into manufacturable, scalable solutions? Are you motivated to push the boundaries of today’s technology by building advanced laser systems that redefine innovation?

**Then this job as senior Specialist – Quantum Laser Systems at Hamamatsu Photonics may be the right opportunity for you!

Being in the middle of the second quantum revolution, this is a great time to join us. Our continued success has set us on an exciting growth path—not just in Denmark, but across our global organization. Hamamatsu Photonics is an inspiring place to work, where we encourage both personal and career development.

You will join a highly skilled and dedicated team of engineers and scientists and become a key contributor in developing advanced laser systems and accessories for cutting-edge quantum applications.

**The Role:

**As a senior member of our Koheras engineering team, you will lead the development, assembly, and testing of custom laser system products and prototypes based on ultra-stable fiber lasers. You will work within a multi-disciplinary team and interface with sales, support, purchasing, and manufacturing to ensure successful transfer of designs to production. You will own several laser projects among various customers and be responsible for delivering robust, manufacturable solutions from requirement capture all the way to deployment.

We are passionate about Quantum Technology! If you feel the same, in this position you will:

• Capture requirements from, and build deep understanding of customer applications in quantum computing and sensing. Further you will translate this understanding into complex and highly specialized fiber laser systems, including:

• Light generation (seed lasers, amplifiers, frequency stabilization)

• Light processing (frequency conversion, electro-optical and acousto-optical modulation, fiber Bragg gratings and more)

• Light delivery (via our proprietary Photonics Crystal Fiber platform)

• Assure manufacturability and production scalability of laser systems aligned with ambitious customer roadmaps

• Support and inspire the development of complex electronics control systems, including analog and digital communication backbones

• Invent and inspire new technology development within fiber-based optics, contributing to IP generation

**More About You:

**As a strong candidate for this position, we hope you can tick most of the following boxes:

• Minimum of a Master’s degree in science or engineering, preferably within a photonics research environment (ideally PhD level education)

• Multiple years of experience in photonics-based quantum computing or sensing applications, ideally in an industrial setting (e.g., ion trapping, neutral atoms, photonic quantum computing, atom interferometry or similar)

• Proven ability to translate quantum application requirements into laser system specifications

• Deep understanding of the fundamental physics and technology around:

• Lasers

• Light amplification

• Non-linear frequency conversion

• Photonic integrated circuits

• Laser frequency metrology and stabilization (e.g. frequency combs) (ideally on fiber-based platforms)

• Expertise in light processing and modulation using electro-optical and acousto-optical technologies (ideally on fiber-based platforms)

• Hands-on lab expertise in free-space and fiber optics

• Proven ability to manage and organize multiple concurrent engineering projects and work packages (ideally in the role of project manager)

• Proven ability to lead and supervise small project teams across disciplines

• Experience in programming (ideally in Python)

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

• Willingness to travel up to 10% annually, potentially globally

**Keep your personal data safe

At a big company, the platform layer is a hundred engineers, and you own a slice of it. A driver. A subsystem. A corner of the release pipeline. You go deep, but you rarely get to hold the whole thing. With us you will. One team owns the entire layer: the operating system and firmware on every Airtame, the streaming stack underneath it, the releases that reach devices in the field, and the work of turning new hardware into a shipping product.

The role is roughly 60% hands-on the hardest problems and 40% growing the engineers who work on them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a change you make to the firmware ships to every Airtame in the field. The team is cross-functional and spread across Europe, and it reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Take AirPlay and Miracast from beta to default. They're in beta today. A year from now they should be solid enough to ship on by default across the Airtame product line, so customers get them without opting in and never have to think about which protocol they're using. Judge it by connection success rates on the fleet, and by how many customers rely on them day to day.

Make firmware releases boring. The best release is the one nobody has to think about: a predictable cadence, an automated quality bar, and shipping to the whole fleet as routine. A year from now, cutting a release should be a low-drama process the team trusts, and that should let you ship improvements more often. Judge it by release frequency, and by the confidence behind each one.

Turn the next board into a shipping Airtame. New silicon has to boot, hold a network, manage its heat, and run conferencing well enough to sell. By year-end there's a repeatable path from a board landing on a desk to a build QA can test, and you own it. Judge it by how long that path takes, and whether the thermal and acoustic targets hold.

Lead the team. You'll run the 1:1s, set the technical bar, and support team members' growth. The measure is simple: a year in, the team runs on your leadership day to day.

Push AI-assisted development further. The team already builds with AI daily. You'll lead the next step: sharper workflows, better tooling choices, new patterns that make the whole group faster. By year-end, the team's AI practices should be visibly ahead of where they started.

Who you are

• The player-coach. You've set a team's technical direction: the architecture calls, the reviews where the hard problems get caught. And you want the people side too. Growing engineers, running 1:1s, hiring. You're not looking to trade one for the other. Maybe you've been a staff engineer or tech lead ready to own a team, or a manager who never stopped writing code. Either way, 60/40 sounds about right to you.

• At home where software meets hardware. Embedded Linux is your familiar ground: the kernel, the BSP, userspace, C and C++ running on the device itself. You've spent time close to the metal: wireless stacks, streaming protocols, drivers. You can reason about a bug whether it lives in the firmware, the network, or the silicon.

• You ship to hardware you can't reach. When it's firmware on a device mounted in someone's meeting room, a bad release doesn't just roll back with a hotfix. You've owned software that ships to the field, so staged rollouts, over-the-air updates, and testing on the devices themselves come naturally. "Works on my bench" isn't the finish line for you.

Department: Program Services

International travel is required depending on program needs. **Minimun 35% travelling

****About The Role

**The Project Manager at HSO is accountable for the successful delivery of a defined project or major workstream within a broader transformation program. This role owns delivery outcomes within clear boundaries: scope, schedule, quality, readiness, and customer adoption for their project.

In this role, your primary focus is on driving execution excellence. You spend most of your time on detailed planning, sequencing, dependency management, readiness control (testing, data, cutover), issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery leadership. You optimize outcomes within given constraints and ensure that delivery reality is visible early.

If you want a role where you own the execution layer of large or complex global programs and make a direct impact on delivery success, this is it.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**

• Own day-to-day delivery of assigned projects or complex program workstreams, ensuring scope, plan, dependencies, and customer readiness remain aligned

• Participate in pre-sales and mobilization by shaping delivery plans, budgets, governance models, and risk assumptions that are executable in practice

jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for a senior hardware/product development engineer with strong experience taking physical products from prototype through engineering validation and into manufacturing.

You will work directly with the founder and take ownership of the physical architecture of Dreamspire.

This is not primarily a firmware role and it is not a pure industrial-design role.

We need someone who can look at a prototype and systematically turn it into a product.

You should be comfortable moving between:

• mechanical engineering

• electronics integration

• manufacturing

• prototyping

• reliability

• assembly

• suppliers

• cost

• compliance

• user experience

A large part of the work will initially be hands-on.

Your first mission

Your first objective will be to create a clear Dreamspire Product Architecture V1.

You will examine the existing prototype, identify its weaknesses and determine how we should build the next generation of the system.

This includes answering questions such as:

• Which prototype mechanisms are suitable for a real product?

• What needs to be redesigned?

• Which components should be custom versus off-the-shelf?

• How should cameras, lighting, electronics and mechanical systems be integrated?

• How do we make assembly simple and repeatable?

• What are the major reliability risks?

• What manufacturing processes should we use?

• What should the production BOM look like?

• What needs tooling?

• What can initially be produced in low volume?

• What compliance and certification work will be required?

• How do we move from one prototype to 10, 100 and eventually thousands of units?

The objective is not to rush into manufacturing.

The objective is to progressively remove technical and manufacturing risk until the product is ready.

Responsibilities

You will:

• Audit the existing Dreamspire hardware and mechanical architecture.

• Design and build improved prototype generations.

• Own mechanical design and product engineering.

• Integrate cameras, PCBs, lighting, power, cabling, connectors and sensors into the physical product.

• Design enclosures, mounts, mechanisms and structural components.

• Define tolerances and mechanical interfaces.

• Design for manufacturing and assembly — DFM/DFA.

• Reduce part count, assembly complexity and manufacturing cost.

• Select appropriate materials and production methods.

• Decide when to use CNC, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding or other processes.

• Work with PCB/electronics engineers where specialist electrical work is required.

• Develop production BOMs and cost estimates.

• Source and evaluate components and suppliers.

• Communicate directly with prototype houses and manufacturers.

• Design test fixtures and production test procedures.

• Establish reliability and lifecycle testing.

• Help define EVT, DVT and PVT stages.

• Identify CE, EMC, electrical safety and other relevant compliance requirements.

• Help design the system for serviceability and repair.

• Help prepare Dreamspire for small pilot production and eventually mass production.

What we are looking for

The most important requirement is:

You have personally helped ship real physical products.

Ideally, you have taken products through several stages of:

prototype → engineering validation → manufacturing → production → customer

You should have strong practical experience with several of the following:

• Mechanical engineering

• Mechatronics

• Consumer electronics

• Product development

• DFM / DFA

• CAD

• Injection-molded plastic parts

• CNC and rapid prototyping

• Electronics packaging

• PCB integration

• Cameras / optical systems

• Sensors

• Motors or electromechanical systems

• Tolerance analysis

• Supplier management

• BOM optimization

• Production testing

• Reliability testing

• Manufacturing ramp-up

You should be comfortable physically building, modifying and debugging prototypes rather than only designing them.

Particularly relevant backgrounds

Experience from products such as these would be especially relevant:

• Consumer electronics

• Robotics

• Smart-home products

• Interactive toys

• Gaming hardware

• IoT products

• Camera systems

• Medical or laboratory devices

• Small electromechanical products

Experience working in a startup or small product-development team is a major advantage.

What we are not looking for

This is probably not the right role if your experience is primarily:

• Arduino hobby projects

• Pure firmware development

• PCB design without product/mechanical ownership

• Industrial design without engineering responsibility

• CAD work without manufacturing experience

• Large-company engineering where manufacturing and suppliers were handled entirely by other teams

We are looking for someone who understands the whole physical product.

How you work

You should enjoy environments where the product is still evolving.

You should be able to say:

“This prototype mechanism works, but it will not survive production.”

or:

“We can remove these five components if we redesign this assembly.”

or:

“Don’t spend money tooling this yet — we need to validate this part first.”

We want someone who challenges assumptions and prevents expensive mistakes rather than simply implementing specifications.

Working with the founder

You will work closely with the founder, who currently develops the software, computer-vision systems, embedded systems and game concepts.

You will therefore have considerable influence over the architecture of the product.

The expectation is that you become the technical owner of the physical Dreamspire platform, while working closely with software and game development.

If the collaboration works well, the role could evolve into something resembling:

Head of Hardware / Head of Product Engineering

as Dreamspire grows.

Location

The role is based around Copenhagen.

Much of the work can be done remotely, but during prototype development we expect regular hands-on work with the physical Dreamspire system.

Candidates elsewhere in Denmark or the Øresund region are welcome if they can work regularly in Copenhagen.

Employment

We are open to:

• Full-time employment

• 3–4 days/week

• An initial senior consulting/fractional arrangement that can develop into a permanent role

For a strong permanent candidate, expected salary is approximately:

65,000–75,000 DKK/month + pension, depending on experience.

Exceptional candidates with significant consumer-product leadership experience may be above this range.

Why this role is interesting

Dreamspire is not another incremental electronics product.

The aim is to create an entirely new category of tabletop gaming platform and then build multiple games on top of it.

The fundamental question is:

Can we create something with the physical presence and social experience of a board game, but with systems and mechanics that were previously only practical in video games?

A large part of whether that succeeds depends on making the hardware disappear into the experience.

That is the problem we want you to help solve.

How to apply

Email jobs@dreamspire.dk with your CV and a few lines about the physical products you have helped ship. We read every application and use it only to assess it; see how we handle your data.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Antenna Systems Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s antenna systems design capability.

You will design and develop antenna systems and subsystems for advanced aerospace and signal-intelligence applications. The work covers antenna-system architecture, performance analysis and design trade-offs, antenna elements and arrays, feed and matching networks, full-wave electromagnetic simulation, platform integration, prototyping, measurement, and performance validation. You will take antenna concepts through detailed design and implementation, including integration with RF hardware, mechanical structures, radomes, and satellite platforms.

You will work closely with system architects, RF and microwave hardware engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, and partner engineering teams. The role requires deep antenna and electromagnetic design expertise, technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototyping and validation to documented, manufacturable, and platform-integrated antenna systems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system and mission requirements into antenna-system architectures, specifications, performance budgets, and design trade-offs. Design antenna elements, arrays, feed and distribution networks, and matching structures.

• Perform antenna-system analysis covering bandwidth, antenna gain, efficiency, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, beamwidth, sidelobe levels, inter element coupling, isolation between antenna channels, phase stability, and platform-integrated antenna performance.

• Perform full-wave electromagnetic simulations and optimization of antennas, arrays, feed structures, radomes, enclosures, supports, and surrounding platform structures.

• Own antenna placement and integration, including antenna-to-platform interaction, RF interfaces, connectors and cabling, grounding, mechanical constraints, and electromagnetic compatibility.

• Define electromagnetic and functional requirements for radomes, antenna supports, enclosures, and fixed or deployable antenna assemblies in collaboration with mechanical design engineers.

• Develop antenna prototypes and engineering models, and lead antenna tuning, troubleshooting, and design verification in collaboration with RF test and characterization engineers.

• Define antenna measurement and validation plans covering input matching and S parameters, radiation patterns, antenna gain, efficiency, polarization, and isolation between antenna channels.

• Analyze measured results, correlate them with electromagnetic simulations, and refine models and designs based on measurement data.

• Support antenna-system calibration and performance assessment for coherent, multichannel, or direction-finding applications.

• Contribute to environmental qualification, reliability assessment, tolerance analysis, manufacturability, supplier selection, and production release.

• Prepare antenna specifications, simulation reports, design documentation, interface definitions, design-review materials, test inputs, and production handover documentation.

• Collaborate with system, RF and microwave hardware, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

Required qualifications and experience

• Master’s degree or PhD in electrical or electronic engineering, antenna engineering, electromagnetics, RF engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 7+ years of professional experience in antenna-system design and development.

• Strong hands-on experience developing antenna elements, arrays, feed networks, matching structures, and antenna systems from initial architecture and full-wave simulation through detailed design, prototyping, integration, and validation.

• Strong understanding of antenna theory and applied electromagnetics, including bandwidth, input matching, antenna gain, efficiency, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, beamwidth, sidelobe levels, inter-element coupling, isolation between antenna channels, and phase stability.

• Demonstrated ability to translate system requirements, coverage requirements, and platform constraints into antenna architectures, performance budgets, and design trade-offs. Proficiency with one or more full-wave electromagnetic simulation tools, such as Ansys HFSS, CST Studio Suite, or equivalent.

• Experience modelling platform-integrated antenna systems, including radomes, supports, enclosures, cabling, grounding, and surrounding platform structures.

• Hands-on experience developing, tuning, troubleshooting, and validating physical antenna prototypes and engineering models.

• Practical experience with antenna measurement techniques, including input matching and multiport S-parameters, radiation-pattern measurements, antenna gain, efficiency, polarization, and isolation between antenna channels.

• Experience using vector network analyzers and antenna measurement facilities, with practical exposure to near-field, compact-range, or direct far-field antenna measurements.

• Demonstrated ability to correlate measured antenna performance with electromagnetic simulations and refine models and designs based on measurement results.

• Experience with engineering analysis and data-processing tools such as MATLAB, Python, or equivalent. Understanding of antenna manufacturing methods, mechanical and dimensional tolerances, environmental requirements and qualification, and production release.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance antenna systems.

• Experience designing wideband or multiband antennas.

• Experience with phased arrays, passive or active beamforming, and antenna-array calibration.

• Experience with coherent or multichannel antenna systems, including phase matching, isolation between antenna channels, and mutual-coupling effects.

• Experience with dual-polarized, circularly polarized, or polarization-diverse antenna systems.

• Experience integrating antennas into satellite, airborne, or other space-constrained platforms.

• Experience with radomes, conformal antennas, deployable antenna systems, or mechanically constrained antenna installations.

• Experience developing aerospace, mission-critical, or ruggedized antenna systems.

• Experience with antenna co-site analysis, electromagnetic interference, and platform-level coupling between antennas and electronic systems.

Success in the first 6 months

• Take technical ownership of one or more antenna systems or subsystem areas.

• Establish the initial antenna architecture, electromagnetic design approach, and platform-integration plan for the assigned scope.

• Deliver reviewed electromagnetic models, design data, interface definitions, and supporting design documentation.

• Develop and validate initial antenna prototypes or engineering models, with clear correlation between simulated and measured performance.

• Identify key antenna-performance, mechanical-integration, and platform interaction risks and define practical mitigation actions.

• Establish effective technical interfaces with system, RF and microwave hardware, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.
